dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: This place is... absolutely buzzing! The fiery energy here could give the forges of the Temple of Pax a run for their money!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're a member of the Saurian Relics Association?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: That's right, haha. I didn't expect to be recognized here. But! Uhh, ahh, the saurian relics... curses, I forgot to look into them at all...

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: I came here because I heard that Nod-Krai had ruins related to saurian relics, but... There's so much here that's new and novel, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: *sigh*... No, no, the funds I've requested are for research purposes. I can't keep buying those funny little machines...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you looking at?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: This fire-breathing behemoth, of course! Truly an incredible machine. It's quite different from our liquid-phlogiston Salutary Furnace back home... Hmm, how should I put this...

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: It operates automatically, and its "structures" are so complex. It's built in a completely different style from what we have back home. Talk about an eye-opener, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Even though I'm standing all the way over here, I can still feel the heat rolling off that furnace in warm, fuzzy waves... Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Strange. It's so comfortable here, but nobody else likes it. It's not like I'm getting hurt or anything...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I won't bother you then.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Hmm... Alright. I'll just stand here a while more, then I'll definitely start looking into those saurian relics...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're warming yourself up by the fire!

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: I'm investigating! *cough* *cough* That's right, I'm investigating here... Just need to warm up a bit from the cold, that's all. It's freezing...

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: So, how're you settling into Nod-Krai?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Good day, Lady Nefer. I don't think I'll ever settle in here — it's just so cold!

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: That said, at least this place is quite warm — if only I could stay here longer! Anyway, about that guide you were helping me find...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I've found you a suitable candidate, but she's busy right now. Be patient. I'll make sure everything's arranged.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: That's wonderful news! *sigh* It really is too cold here — I should warm up a little longer...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Well then, is the problem solved?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Indeed it is! Thank you, Lady Nefer. I'll make sure your fee is paid in the usual manner. I may have further matters that require your assistance in the not-too-distant future...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Lovely. I look forward to another fruitful collaboration.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Good game! Haha, looks like luck was on my side this time!

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Well played! It's been a long time since I've had this much fun!
